params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P3
Summary: The bell notification that a vehicle changed hands through the shared stock ("Vehicle sold: ...", "Bought over by ... through the shared stock.") appears in English for Dutch-speaking garages.

## What happens

After a buy-over through the shared stock, the selling garage's bell showed "Vehicle sold: VW Golf VII / Bought over by <garage> through the shared stock." in English, while the app is in Dutch.

## Cause

`Helpers\Vehicle::notifyBothSides` sets the notification locale to the garage's language shortcode as stored, `NL` in capitals. There is no `lang/NL`, so Laravel falls back to `fallback_locale` (`en`). The existing test passed a lowercase `nl` and never saw it. `Notify::localeFor` already normalises the code and prefers the user's own language over the garage's; `Notify::dealerWith` did not use it.

## Expected

Each user of the garage reads the message in their own language (else the garage's), like `Notify::dealerTranslated` already does.

Source: Portal mail:22 (onboarding feedback, 2026-10-16).
params.title: Bell notification for a shared-stock sale appears in English
